review.intent_summary: Agents can analyze a request, page through its findings, and retrieve supporting samples, assessments, readiness, and relationship lineage.

criteria.criterion: The analyze tool returns a compact headline, finding preview, and run ID for subsequent evidence requests.
list_findings pages through cases, candidates, episodes, patterns, and data-quality findings.
get_evidence exposes the selected finding's numerical support and relationship source lineage.
Unavailable latest evidence and non-triggering early candidates remain visible, while large pattern sample sets are paginated.

verification_evidence: Primary Codex agent inspected every declared implementation reference and compared acceptance criteria with current source and test assertions; this is a fresh semantic review, completed in the existing session.
Followed analyze, list_findings and get_evidence for conversion: observed 8/130 versus expected 0.1, source indexes 14/14 and not_assessed readiness support the compact headline.
